Oldred is one of the most valuable moons in the system. Not for its many riches but for its remarkable amount of oil. For this reason, during hard times of death and destruction, oil extraction sites were made. But nobody knew how big of a mistake this was until it was too late.

> Moon Map

> Moon Info

POPULATION: Deceased.

CONDITIONS: Hot thin terrain, no surviving flora, high pressure within outer crust.

FAUNA: A desperate ecosystem, remaining fauna display agressive behaviour.

> Weather Conditions

Oldred can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Minefield weather by default.

> Moon Exclusive Content

Inside & Outside Ambience

On Oldred you can hear two ambiences. One plays inside while the other one plays outside.

Outside Ambience

Inside Ambience

Geysers

Oldred's exterior has geysers of boiling oil that shoot upward periodically, primarily on the catwalks. These geysers rapidly deal 3 damage per hit to any player that walks into them.

Hanging Mines

Oldred's interior has a unique map hazard called a "Hanging mine". These mines deal 10 damage to any player that walks into them. Throughout the day, a blast radius will pulse out from a mine accompanied by a beeping sound. The blast radius will then pulse out again and the beeping sound will increase in speed before the mine explodes. Any player that is within the blast radius when the explosion occurs will take 70, 90, 99, or 9,999,999 damage depending on the proximity to the mine itself. The explosion goes through all obstructions.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Logging "Radio message 1" found on the exterior of Motra.
Alternatively, inserting the Oldred videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interiors of Etern, Infernis, Lecaro, or Polarus into the projector in Galetry.

Unlocks

Trite: Log "Radio message 2" found on the exterior.
Duckstroid-14: Interact with the grafitti that says "WHERE IS DUCKSTROID-14?" found on the exterior.
Etern: Etern videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.

> Lore

Radio Message 2

Radio message 2 continues the story of the Across The Stars radio host, unlocking Trite when logged. They comment on the state of the war and mention a safe haven for civilians: The Domes of Demetrica.

Text ⁠
You are now listening to
-Across The Stars-
I'm your favourite radio host and I'm here with your 11 AM news.
On the dot for a change.
It looks like our Thursday will be sunny with little clouds in the sky.
Always nice after nothing but storms.

Just like the past weeks the war is still raging on and we don’t see it ending anytime soon with how things are currently going.
In fact, the new factories on Oldred are doing nothing but throwing more gas on the fire.
As if the inferno isn’t large enough.
Cities are burning and for what.
Surely not for sticks and marshmallows...
I bring good news too though.
There have been talks of a safe place away from the war.
A place to hide out until the nightmare is over.
Somewhere to live.
The Domes of Demetrica.

I’m out of time, I’ve got some more hits coming up to fill up the void of your day to day work schedule.
Stay tuned and thank you for listening to
-Across The Stars-

Transcripts / Interviews

Transcripts can randomly spawn as scrap within the interior. They are interviews of various employees that worked on Oldred.

Transcript 1

Image & Text ⁠
Transcript: interview one

Year: 3

Day: 74

Employee: 15-1


Interviewer: How pleased are you with this job?

Employee: It's alright, it gets the family paid.

Interviewer: How are the working conditions?

Employee: It's not the worst, a few accidents have happened but so far it's been OK.

Interviewer: How would you recommend this job?

Employee: I can't say I'd recommend this job but if you are in desperate need of money like most of us, it's an alright job.

Where is Duckstroid-14?

After leaving the ship, when you approach the rightmost building, you can find graffiti on one of the walls that says "Where is Duckstroid-14?", which you can interact with. When you proceed to do so a strange audio will play. After that Duckstroid-14 will be unlocked for you.

Image & Text ⁠
Far from the realms of logic, there floats a giant duck, I don't know why it's there, but I don't give a fuck.

Oldred Videotape

If the player finds the Oldred videotape on other moons and inserts it into the projector in Galetry, they will view a tape of an employee being put into a room with a puzzle trap and a mysterious person challenging them to escape with another trapped employee.
This videotape can be found on Etern, Trite, Polarus, Lecaro, Infernis and Titan.

Text ⁠
Hello employee.
You may not know me but.. I know you.
Since the death of your soulmate you have been taken by grief, you have felt like your existence is once again pointless.
You continuously put yourself in danger, inching closer and closer to the end each time.
Lets see if you have what it takes to survive, if you still appreciate the body that has been given to you.
In front of you there hangs a Decimator, an explosive device that will destroy everything in this room when the timer hits zero.
There also hangs another employee, you may know him as he has been in your crew for months, he will be the key to your freedom, All you need to do is remove the right wire with the knife you now posses.
But beware, if he dies by your hands, neither of you will make it out alive.
Live or die, make your choice.

> Trivia

  • A "WALL OF THE LOST" can be found to the right of the main entrance and on the wall to the left of the middle fire exit on the map. Most of the list is filled with random employees that died on Oldred, but it also references several streamers, mod developers, or people credited with helping in the creation of Wesley's Moons:
    • Magoroku, a streamer who is credited with multiplayer testing and voice acting the Across The Stars radio host in Wesley's Moons.
    • Thorlar, a streamer who also created the Health Station mod for Lethal Company.
    • PsychHypnotic, a streamer.
    • Shooshies, a streamer who is credited with writing, testing, and voice acting for Captain Cunningham in Wesley's Moons.
    • JOJOsaysbreee, a streamer.
    • Insym, a streamer.
    • Wesley, the creator of this mod.
    • MrCompost, who is credited with sound design and testing for Wesley's Moons.
    • Andrew, who is credited with testing and waddling for Wesley's Moons.
    • Takerst, a streamer.
    • Lunxara, a streamer and mod developer.
    • Generic_GMD, a mod developer who is credited with testing, music, modeling, and "enduring my sanity inducing nonsense" by Wesley for Wesley's Moons.
    • Nikki, a mod developer who is credited with testing and wiki stuff by Wesley for Wesley's Moons.
    • Kenji, a mod developer who is credited with voice acting for the Trial Victim, radar map tool, video editing, and testing by Wesley for Wesley's Moons.
  • There is a 5% chance for a "fun" button to spawn behind the main building. Pressing this button will cause the sun to become a disco ball, a slowed version of the vanilla disco ball track to start playing both inside and outside the facility, and the moon to act as if it is eclipsed(citation needed).
  • The Oldred videotape is a reference to the horror media franchise Saw, based on the puzzle trap, the name "Jigsaw?", the main antagonist of the series, being displayed in the Wesley's Moons credits as voiced by Wesley and presumably being the mysterious voice in the tape, and "Live or die. Make your choice." being an iconic quote in the series.
